descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Chika' Rare Chika Weeping Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 Good gifts often come from great people. 'Chika' was given to us by good friends Hisanori Kojima and Chikako Kojima of Japan. We met them years ago when they interned at a friend's nursery just 15 minutes from ours. Later we had the privilege of visiting their home and nursery in Japan. To us, this tree is a symbol of great friendship. 'Chika' is a weeping Japanese maple with small green leaves palmate leaves in the spring that turn to a spectacular yellow to orange in the fall. The bark appears to be lime-green on new growth, which can be quite attractive. According to Hisanori, 'Chika' originated at a temple in Chikako's home town. 'Chika' is extremely vigorous and cascading reaching 5-6 ft in height by 7-8 ft in width in 15 years.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Chika' 稀有垂枝日本枫，适生区 5-9。 珍贵的礼物往往来自珍贵的人。 ‘Chika’ 是日本好友 Hisanori Kojima 和 Chikako Kojima 赠送给我们的品种。 多年前，他们曾在距离我们苗圃仅 15 分钟车程的一位朋友的苗圃实习，我们因此相识。 后来，我们也有幸造访他们在日本的家与苗圃。 对我们而言，这棵树象征着深厚的友谊。 ‘Chika’ 是一款垂枝型日本枫，春季叶片小而呈掌状，绿色清雅，秋季则转为极为绚丽的黄色至橙色。 新梢树皮呈青柠绿色，也颇具观赏性。 据 Hisanori 介绍，‘Chika’ 最初发现于 Chikako 家乡的一座寺庙中。 ‘Chika’ 生长势极强，枝条下垂飘逸，15 年可达 5-6 英尺高、7-8 英尺宽。
